triggers.budget_buckets_counts_insert: CREATE TRIGGER "budget_buckets_counts_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "sys_api_budget_buckets" WHEN NOT (NEW.capacity >= 0 AND NEW.refill_rate >= 0) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'budget_buckets_counts'); END
triggers.budget_buckets_counts_update: CREATE TRIGGER "budget_buckets_counts_update" BEFORE UPDATE ON "sys_api_budget_buckets" WHEN NOT (NEW.capacity >= 0 AND NEW.refill_rate >= 0) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'budget_buckets_counts'); END

triggers.budget_reservations_counts_insert: CREATE TRIGGER "budget_reservations_counts_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "sys_api_budget_reservations" WHEN NOT (NEW.estimate >= 0 AND NEW.charged >= 0) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'budget_reservations_counts'); END
triggers.budget_reservations_counts_update: CREATE TRIGGER "budget_reservations_counts_update" BEFORE UPDATE ON "sys_api_budget_reservations" WHEN NOT (NEW.estimate >= 0 AND NEW.charged >= 0) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'budget_reservations_counts'); END
triggers.budget_reservations_keys_insert: CREATE TRIGGER "budget_reservations_keys_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "sys_api_budget_reservations" WHEN NOT (json_array_length(NEW.keys) = 4) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'budget_reservations_keys'); END
triggers.budget_reservations_keys_update: CREATE TRIGGER "budget_reservations_keys_update" BEFORE UPDATE ON "sys_api_budget_reservations" WHEN NOT (json_array_length(NEW.keys) = 4) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'budget_reservations_keys'); END
triggers.budget_reservations_state_insert: CREATE TRIGGER "budget_reservations_state_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "sys_api_budget_reservations" WHEN NOT (NEW.state IN ('held', 'settled', 'rejected', 'abandoned')) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'budget_reservations_state'); END
triggers.budget_reservations_state_update: CREATE TRIGGER "budget_reservations_state_update" BEFORE UPDATE ON "sys_api_budget_reservations" WHEN NOT (NEW.state IN ('held', 'settled', 'rejected', 'abandoned')) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'budget_reservations_state'); END
